title: Unit – 5 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1  |  Flynn's Taxonomy — Systems
sections: 1. b) Number of instruction streams and data streams.
2. c) SISD — the traditional single-core, single-stream machine.
3. d) SIMD — GPUs apply one instruction to many data elements.
4. c) MIMD — multicore processors run independent instruction streams per core.
5. c) MISD — multiple instruction streams on a single data stream.
2. FALSE — SIMD is one instruction stream on multiple data streams.
5. FALSE — MISD is uncommon; general-purpose systems are SISD/SIMD/MIMD.
Answer: b) Current: SIMD | Upgrade: MIMD.
Current design: the same prediction algorithm runs on different data portions simultaneously — one instruction stream over many data streams = SIMD.
After upgrade: different algorithms run simultaneously on different data = multiple instruction streams and multiple data streams = MIMD.
